value.rationale: The new 2026 general convexification theory motivates the exact threshold for the first nonsimplex full-affine-moduli polygon family. All nondegenerate quadrilaterals are classified by two diagonal ratios, including the sharp index-one equality shape and complete attainable index range. The invariant is a natural quantitative measure of how quickly a finite vertex set becomes convex upon dilation with its hull; a complete all-shapes formula provides geometrically useful content not reducible to a textbook inequality.
